remarks: Welcome to this pristine, fully remodeled 2-bedroom, 2-bath townhome in West Norwalk's highly desirable Ledgebrook community. Offering 1,662 sq ft of beautifully updated living space, this sun-filled unit features an open-concept layout, gleaming hardwood floors, and a welcoming 2-story foyer. The custom kitchen boasts rich cabinetry, under-cabinet lighting, and a cozy dining nook that opens to an expansive living and dining area-complete with a fireplace, perfect for entertaining. Step outside to your private deck overlooking the peaceful brook-a serene retreat just off the living room. The spacious primary suite includes a walk-in closet and a luxurious en-suite bath with custom cabinetry and a soaking tub. The second bedroom is bright and airy, with double closets and easy access to the fully renovated hall bath. A separate home office adds flexibility for today's lifestyle. Additional features include a private, covered garage and in-unit laundry.Ledgebrook offers a beautifully maintained setting with fantastic amenities including a pool, hot tub, sauna, fitness center, and clubhouse. Ideally located just minutes to the train, shopping, dining, beaches, and golf. This is the one you've been waiting for-don't miss it!
